name: Skeleton
description: Widgets-only loading placeholder with a repeating shimmer sweep; replaces the banned skeletonizer package.

fields.fromColor: ThemedColor? - leading sweep fill; null = muted
fields.toColor: ThemedColor? - trailing sweep fill; null = accent
fields.duration: Duration? - one sweep; null = 800ms, scaled by motion intensity
fields.curve: Curve? - sweep easing; null = motion standard curve
fields.lineHeight: double? - text-line height; null = density bodyTextSize
fields.lineGap: double? - gap between lines; null = density gap
fields.avatarSize: double? - avatar diameter; null = density controlHeight
fields.rowHeight: double? - list/table row height; null = density rowMinHeight
fields.surfaceOpacity: double? - card surface opacity; null = ambient
fields.surfaceBlur: double? - card surface blur; null = ambient

notes: `package:skeletonizer` is banned; the shimmer is a gradient driven by `RepeatedAnimationBuilder`.
Shape placeholders (text line, avatar) render the shimmer in content geometry; composed placeholders (card, list, table) cover loading states.
`SkeletonMirror` sizes a placeholder from the real child's box via an invisible layout child.
